seo.description: A short letter from Noor Haddad: who I am, what I am working on this year, and how to reach me.

props.title: Hello, I'm Noor.
props.text:
I translate novels from Arabic into English, and when the novels are slow I teach. I live in Marseille with a cat who disapproves of both jobs.

This year I am working on a long book about a family of clockmakers in Aleppo. It is the hardest thing I have tried: every chapter is told by a different clock. It should be out next autumn.

I answer every letter, though not quickly. If you are a publisher, a student, or someone who has found a mistake in one of my translations, I would like to hear from you, especially the last one.
